# Fourthwall sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Catch up on missed Fourthwall events

Asks Fourthwall which events it sent and runs those that never reached Cuebot (relay down, wrong secret). Cuebot also does this every few minutes (Webhooks page). Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.catchUp`</small>

## Create Fourthwall giveaway links

Makes Fourthwall giveaway links for a product: each link lets one person claim it for free. Send one to a winner by whisper or DM. Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Product id** | The product's id. |
| **How many links** | How many links. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fw.giveawayLinks%` | The links, separated by spaces |
| `%fw.giveawayLink0%` | The first link (use 1, 2... for the next ones) |
| `%fw.giveawayPackageId%` | The id of this batch of links |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.createGiveawayLinks`</small>

## Create Fourthwall members post

Posts to your Fourthwall members, for example "I'm live!" when the stream starts. With a video link it is a video post. Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The post's title (at least 3 characters). Starts as: `I'm live!`. |
| **Text** | The text of the post. Starts as: `Come hang out: https://twitch.tv/%broadcastUserName%`. |
| **Video link (optional)** | Optional. A YouTube or Twitch link to embed. |
| **Who can see it** | Who can see it: MembersOnly, Public or FreeAndPaidMembers. Options: MembersOnly, Public, FreeAndPaidMembers. Starts as: `MembersOnly`. |
| **Notify members** | Tick to notify members. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fw.postId%` | The new post's id |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.createPost`</small>

## Create Fourthwall promo code

Makes a new discount code in your Fourthwall shop, for "first 10 chatters get 20% off", raid rewards or channel point redeems. Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Code** | The code. Leave empty for a random one like STREAM7K2QXP. |
| **Discount** | Percent off, Amount off (in the currency below) or Free shipping. Options: Percent off, Amount off, Free shipping. Starts as: `Percent off`. |
| **Percent or amount** | The percent, or the amount off. Starts as: `10`. |
| **Currency (amount off)** | The currency for Amount off, like USD. Starts as: `USD`. |
| **Max uses (0 = no limit)** | How many times it can be used in total. 0 = no limit. Starts as: `10`. |
| **Once per customer** | Tick so each customer can use it once. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fw.code%` | The new code |
| `%fw.promotionId%` | Its id (End promo code can use it) |
| `%fw.promotionStatus%` | Its status, like Live |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.createPromo`</small>

## End Fourthwall promo code

Ends a Fourthwall discount code (or makes it live again). Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Code or promotion id** | The code, like STREAM20, or the promotion id. %fw.code% is the one Create promo code made. Starts as: `%fw.code%`. |
| **Make it live again instead** | Tick to make the code live again instead of ending it. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fw.promotionStatus%` | Its status now |
| `%fw.usageCount%` | How many times it was used |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.endPromo`</small>

## Get Fourthwall members

Reads how many Fourthwall members you have, in total and per tier, and can check whether an email belongs to a member. Counts come from webhooks and, with the Fourthwall API connected, the member list.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Check this email (optional)** | Optional. An email to check, for example from a form or a command. Needs the API's member list. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fourthwallMemberCount%` | How many active members |
| `%fourthwallTiers%` | Each tier with its member count, like "Gold (3), Silver (10)" |
| `%fourthwallMembers.<tier>%` | The member count of one tier, like %fourthwallMembers.Gold% |
| `%isFourthwallMember%` | True when the email belongs to an active member |
| `%fourthwallMemberTier%` | That member's tier |
| `%fourthwallMemberState%` | That member's state, like ACTIVE |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.getMembers`</small>

## Get Fourthwall sales totals

Reads your Fourthwall sales since today, the last 24 hours, this stream or this month: purchases (not samples, claimed gifts or cancelled orders) and completed donations. Good for merch goals that survive a restart. Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Since** | Since when: Today, Last 24 hours, This stream (the hours below) or This month. Options: Today, Last 24 hours, This stream (hours below), This month. Starts as: `Today`. |
| **Hours (for this stream)** | For This stream: how many hours back. Starts as: `4`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fourthwallRevenue%` | What the orders came to |
| `%fourthwallOrders%` | How many orders |
| `%fourthwallDonations%` | What the donations came to |
| `%fourthwallDonationCount%` | How many donations |
| `%fourthwallTotal%` | Orders and donations added up |
| `%fourthwallFormattedTotal%` | The total written nicely, like "$120.00" |
| `%fourthwallCurrency%` | The currency, like USD |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.getTotals`</small>

## Get Fourthwall thank-yous waiting

Lists supporters still waiting for a Fourthwall thank-you, to show or read out on stream. Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **At most** | At most this many. Starts as: `10`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fourthwallThankYouCount%` | How many are waiting (up to the maximum) |
| `%fourthwallThankYouNames%` | Their names, joined with commas |
| `%thankYou0.id%` | The first one's id, for Send thank-you video (use 1, 2... for the next ones) |
| `%thankYou0.name%` | The first one's name |
| `%thankYou0.products%` | What they bought |
| `%thankYou0.message%` | Their message |
| `%thankYou0.amount%` | What they paid |
| `%thankYou0.formattedAmount%` | What they paid, written nicely |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.getThankYous`</small>

## Refresh Fourthwall showcase products

Reads your Fourthwall products again for the Products widget (Cuebot also does it after a product change and every 30 minutes). Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.refreshProducts`</small>

## Send Fourthwall thank-you video

Sends a video or picture as the thank-you to a Fourthwall supporter, for example an OBS replay you just saved. Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Thank-you id** | Which supporter: the id from Get thank-yous waiting. Starts as: `%thankYou0.id%`. |
| **Video or picture file** | The video or picture file on this PC. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fw.mediaUrl%` | Where the thank-you is now |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.sendThankYou`</small>

## Set Fourthwall streaming status

Tells Fourthwall your shop is streaming on Twitch (or that the stream ended). Viewers can only buy stream gifts while it is. Cuebot can also do this by itself (Webhooks page). Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Streaming now** | Tick for streaming now, untick for ended. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Twitch user id** | Your Twitch user id. Starts as: `%broadcastUserId%`. |
| **Twitch login** | Your Twitch login name. Starts as: `%broadcastUserName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.setStreaming`</small>

## Show or hide Fourthwall product or collection

Shows or hides a Fourthwall product or collection, for a limited drop while you are live. Needs the Fourthwall API connected on the Webhooks page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **What** | Product or Collection. Options: Product, Collection. Starts as: `Product`. |
| **Product id, or collection id or slug** | The product's id, or the collection's id or slug (from its web address). |
| **Available** | Tick to show it, untick to hide it again. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fourthwallOk%` | True when Fourthwall did it |
| `%fourthwallResult%` | What happened, or why it failed |

<small>Type id: `fourthwall.setAvailability`</small>
